newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Utah selected as cosmic ray detector site.
newsitem.headline: Utah selected as cosmic ray detector site.

text.p: Space scientists from 10 nations have selected Millard County, Utah, as the site for a new cosmic rays monitoring centre, Argentina's state-run Telam news agency reported on Saturday.
Telam said more than 100 scientists met for a week in San Rafael in western Argentina to select the site for the centre, which will monitor radiation originating in outer space.
The new site will function in parallel with one to be built in Argentina. Candidates for the northern hemisphere space probe centre were the United States, Spain and Mexico.
The space scientists opted for Millard County, in Utah, after two rounds of voting.
Telam quoted John Harton, a Colorado State University physicist, as saying his colleagues favoured his country because of the experience "we Americans have in this kind of project."
